label: preparing
what: A specific order of 200 loaves of bread: baker is making bread while freight supplies wheat (and hay blocks converted to wheat) and transports finished bread. The secretary's written account explicitly records the order and planned additional delivery. Records show mayor informed about mill-supply enquiries/order by the time he reads the book at day 0, 18:09, so it was not necessarily kept from him; the visible book records convey this to him, despite earlier activity preceding that notice.
